register.labelZh: FINISH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: finish something off 可以表示完成最後剩餘的部分;finish something up 則可以表示把整項工作完成。；finish off with something 可以指出最後的食物、飲品或活動。；finish up 可以表示某人最後到了哪裏,或結果做了甚麼事情。；finish somebody or something off 可以表示徹底擊敗或摧毀,也可以表示令人筋疲力盡。；finish with somebody 可以表示結束感情關係;finish with something 則可以表示已用完或不再需要某物。
register.summaryEn: Finish something off can describe completing the last remaining part, while finish something up can describe completing the whole task. Finish off with something lets you name the final food, drink or activity. Finish up can show where someone finally goes or what someone eventually does. Finish somebody or something off can describe complete defeat or destruction. It can also describe extreme tiredness. Finish with somebody can describe ending a relationship, while finish with something can show that you no longer need it.
